exposure: transient occlusion of the uterine artery (TOUA)
cohort: This case series included three women with highly vascular uterine benign diseases and a high risk of intra-operative heavy bleeding, including cesarean scar pregnancy, hydatidiform mole on a cesarean scar, and cervical pregnancy, who desired to preserve their fertility and uterus.
finding: Laparoscopic TOUA was successfully used to control intra-operative bleeding and safely conserve the uterus in three cases of women with highly vascular uterine benign diseases who were at high risk of heavy bleeding during surgery.
mod_finding: The study included cases of cesarean scar pregnancy and hydatidiform mole on a cesarean scar.
